messages:
mika: Heads-up: us-central2 showing a weird packing pattern since 03:10 UTC. Lots of tiny jobs pinned to a handful of nodes, mediums can't binpack and we're seeing preempt evictions + bump in unit GPU-hours.

dan: Any recent taint or label flips?

mika: infra applied a nic-label rollout (node.k8s.redwood/nic-profile=segmented) last night and also enabled a conservative network-scheduling heuristic. Seems the scheduler started refraining from co-locating pods with different nic-profile on the same host.

priya: Scheduler scoring trace: `score(hostA)=32, hostB=31` but a high egress penalty kept many small pods scattered. Also saw repeated attach failures: `attach: egress qlen > threshold` in pod events.

tom: Node conntrack noise too?

mika: Yep, conntrack WARN on several nodes in rack-9. Not full exhaustion but high churn.

infra-bot: Incident INC-2026-6999 created and paging oncall.

dan: Quick mitigation idea: allow best-effort tiny pod co-location by adding an override label (apps/pack-hint=allow-coalesce) and enable a per-az packer soft-merge for <0.25 GPU pods.

priya: I prototyped a scheduler tweak yesterday that prefers homogeneous packing when >60% of pending are tiny. Could flip that as an emergency config flag.

mika: (typo) mika: +1 to the emergency flag. Also propose a short-term conntrack sysctl bump on affected nodes and a focused warmpool scale-up for rack-9.

dan: ops, can you run conntrack bump and apply the override label to tiny-runner in us-central2a?

ops: Doing sysctl bump: net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max -> 300k on rack-9 nodes. Patching tiny-runner with pack-hint label in us-central2a.

priya: After label patch in canary AZ pending dropped ~70% and eviction rate halved. I'll open a PR to add the emergency homogeneous-pack flag and add NIC egress pressure as a soft penalty instead of a hard veto.

dan: Also request telemetry: per-node tiny_pod_skew and a rack-level packing_entropy metric. Those would have flagged this earlier.

mika: Cost note: estimate ~28% extra vGPU-hours during the 90m incident window if we don't fix packing heuristics. Adding to postmortem.

infra-bot: Rollout pause applied for nic-profile in us-central2 at 03:45 UTC.

ops: Canary looks good. Pending down from 142 to 41. We'll keep the sysctl change for 4h and monitor. Alert: evictions.pods.rate > 5/min -> notify #eng-platform.
